videos.script: Somewhere in Thursday's 612 MB there may have been names and e-mail addresses of real people. That turns a security incident into a legal obligation. {{law}} In Brazil the obligation is in the LGPD, and the rules for meeting it are the ANPD's. {{anpd}} This lesson follows the decision the way the DPO and the lawyer make it: was personal data involved, could it cause relevant risk to the people it belongs to, and if so, who is told, what, and by when. {{decision}} The clock is counted in business days, and you will count it with a short program. And whatever is decided, it is written down and kept, because the decision not to notify has to be defended too. {{record}}
